I love the stuff. Here's what I like to do:

  • Fire up the smoker

  • Cut a squash in half, gut it

  • Chop up a sweet onion, a green pepper, a red pepper, and maybe a jalapeno if I'm feeling spicy

  • Once the grill's hot, throw the squash in there - cook time varies on the size of the squash and temp of the grill. Typically takes ~45 mins

  • While the squash is in the smoker, brown some lean ground beef on a 10-inch skillet

  • De-glaze your skillet by throwing in the chopped veggies after you take the beef out. I keep them in there until they're nice and soft.

  • Add whatever spaghetti sauce you like, throw the beef in there too, let simmer for a few minutes.

  • Once your squash is ready, take it out and gut it with a fork

  • Mix the guts with your meat/veggie/sauce combo

  • For bonus points, use the empty squash as a serving dish. Add cheese, throw it back on the grill (or broiler) to melt the cheese.

So good.
